project_info.name: PratoDigital - Cardápio Digital & Sistema para Restaurantes
project_info.target_audience: Restauranteurs, donos de bares, lanchonetes, cafeterias e clientes finais (comensais)

color_palette.mode: Dual Context (Warm Cream Light Mode for Marketing/Public Menu & High-Contrast Slate Dark Mode for Kitchen Panel)

scale.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-none

landing_page.navbar: Fixed blurred glass header (`bg-stone-50/80 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-stone-200 z-50`). Includes logo, link options ('Recursos', 'Como Funciona', 'Planos', 'Demonstração'), and CTA 'Teste 30 Dias Grátis' / 'Área do Restaurante'.
landing_page.hero: Asymmetric bento dynamic hero with live interactive QR Code simulator, key benefits tag ('Sem comissão por pedido'), headline 'Seu cardápio digital moderno, sem complicação.', and direct CTA button to register.
landing_page.live_demo_section: Interactive preview where visitors can switch between owner manager panel view and customer phone view.
landing_page.pricing_plans: 3 distinct plans card matrix: 'Simples' (R$ 49/mês), 'Intermediário' (R$ 99/mês - Destacado com badge 'Mais Popular'), 'Avançado' (R$ 189/mês). All plans showcase 30 days free trial callout.
landing_page.features_bento: 6-grid Bento box: Instant QR Code, Live Kitchen Board, Printable Receipts, AI Promotions Generator, Analytics & Metrics, Mobile Responsive Speed.
landing_page.footer: Rich dark footer with quick links, support info, and restaurant tech tips.

owner_dashboard.layout: Sidebar navigation (Visão Geral, Gerenciador de Cardápio, QR Code & Mesas, Cozinha ao Vivo, Promoções IA, Configurações do Plano) + Top bar with restaurant status toggle ('Aberto' / 'Fechado').
owner_dashboard.menu_manager: Category accordion builder with dish add/edit modal (name, price, category, photo URL/upload simulator, description, status 'Disponível'/'Esgotado').
owner_dashboard.qr_generator: Custom QR code generator for tables (Mesa 01, Mesa 02, Balcão, Delivery) with instant SVG download & print layout preview.
owner_dashboard.kitchen_live_board: Real-time column layout: 'Novos' (Blue), 'Em Preparo' (Amber), 'Prontos' (Green). Sound notification toggle, order detail view, and 'Imprimir Comprovante' thermal receipt modal.
owner_dashboard.ai_promo_tool: AI-powered promotional message generator for WhatsApp/SMS. Presets ('Cupom Sextou', 'Happy Hour 2x1', 'Lançamento de Prato'). Generates copy instantly with quick copy-to-clipboard button and audience selector.

customer_mobile_menu.layout: Mobile viewport container (max-w-md mx-auto), header with restaurant banner, table badge (ex: 'Mesa 04'), search input, horizontal scrolling category pills.
customer_mobile_menu.item_card: Horizontal or grid card with image thumbnail, title, description, price (R$ XX,XX), and counter button (+ / -).
customer_mobile_menu.floating_cart: Fixed bottom bar showing items count, total value, and 'Ver Pedido' button.
customer_mobile_menu.checkout_modal: Customer name, table number / takeout confirmation, item review, order note, and 'Enviar Pedido para Cozinha' button. Live status updates step ('Pedido Recebido' -> 'Em Preparo' -> 'Pronto').

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, filters, tabs, status badges, cart items, print triggers) MUST include a kebab-case data-testid attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard JavaScript React (.js files, NOT .tsx).
Keep all copy natural and fluent in Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR).
Provide seed mock data for 3 restaurants (e.g. 'Sabor & Arte Bistro', 'Pizzaria Bella Napoli', 'Burger Craft Lab') so demo is vibrant out of the box.
Ensure state changes (e.g., adding menu item, placing order, updating order status to kitchen, generating AI promo text) immediately update UI and notify with Sonner toasts.
Do not use dark flat blanket overlays over hero images; use subtle background gradients or warm solid cards.
Ensure 30-day free trial ('30 Dias Grátis') is prominently highlighted across marketing headers, hero section, and pricing plan cards.
